children: WhiteFiber, through its subsidiary Enovum Data Centers, completed a $60 million acquisition of industrial buildings and surrounding land in Yadkin County, North Carolina, from Unifi Manufacturing. The properties are expected to have a combined minimum of 60 megawatts of power, with potential capacity of up to 198 megawatts, subject to confirmation. Unifi retained occupancy rights over part of the property under post-closing arrangements.
: Real estate purchase and sale agreement
: Acquire powered properties for anticipated data center development
